title: Term list vocabulary
description: Words and phrases a source, ranking rule or pattern can use by code, grouped and labelled. A list belongs to one scope (global, a country, or a named source) and may extend lists of its own scope or global; groups with the same name merge across the lists a consumer loads, and terms with the same value merge their aliases. The web classification data has its own typed schema in web.schema.json. Vector settings are not defined yet: the vector store is only a skeleton.

extends.description: Codes of term lists this one builds on. Each must be in this list's scope or global; a global list extends none.

languages.description: Languages the list's terms and aliases are written in (BCP 47 primary tags such as en, sw). A term or alias without its own language takes the first one.

terms.description: Terms that belong to no group. Use groups for anything a ranking rule will refer to.

group.description: The group's name. Groups with this name in other loaded lists are the same group.

role.description: How consumers use the group: kind (what a document is), subject (what it is about) or stopword (ignored when tokenising).

value.description: The canonical term. Matches of any alias count as this term.
